wiki.title: Steve D. Lanier
wiki.extract: Steve D. Lanier (born 1966) is an American politician serving as a Republican member of the New Mexico Senate for the 2nd district, which covers the north-eastern section of San Juan County, including many towns northeast of Farmington, New Mexico.
